hero.title: Your entire shop in one place.
hero.subtitle: Products, orders, inventory, website, marketing, and customer service — without the app switching.
hero.description: Online shops, retail stores, handmade goods, food producers, wholesale, subscription boxes, and anyone who sells physical or digital products.

section1.heading: Do the math on your current stack
section1.p1: Shopify: $39/month. Mailchimp: $20/month. Later for social: $25/month. Gorgias for support: $60/month. A spreadsheet you maintain by hand for "real" inventory numbers. Squarespace for the website you update separately from your actual product catalog. A sticky note reminding you to reorder packaging from a supplier whose number is in your phone contacts.
section1.p2: That's $144 a month in software — before accounting for the time you spend moving data between all of them.

section2.heading: Where the time goes
section2.p1: Four minutes to answer one "where's my order?" email. Check Shopify for the order, the shipping site for tracking, compose the reply in Gmail with the tracking number pasted in. Multiply by twelve customers a day. That's forty-eight minutes on a task that could be handled by an AI that already knows the order status and the tracking number.
section2.p2: An entire afternoon to run a promotion. Your email list is in Mailchimp. Your purchase history is in Shopify. Your social content is managed through Later. A 15%-off campaign for returning customers means exporting data from one tool, importing it into another, and manually coordinating across a third.
section2.p3: A popular item goes out of stock because the reorder reminder was an email you buried last week. Now you're expediting at double the shipping cost and losing sales in the meantime.

section3.heading: What changes with HABOS
section3.p1: One dashboard. Orders, stock levels, and customer messages in the same view. When a shipping inquiry comes in, the AI already has the order status and tracking number — it drafts the reply overnight. You review three of them in thirty seconds over your morning coffee.
section3.p2: When stock runs low, HABOS flags it three days before you'd notice. A purchase order is drafted with your usual supplier at the usual quantity. You approve it on your phone while walking to lunch.
section3.voiceNote: "VOIS, create a campaign for returning customers — 15% off, email and Instagram, running next week."
section3.voiceResult: AI pulls repeat customers from CRM. Drafts email copy in your brand voice. Suggests Instagram caption with your best-selling product photo. You tweak the subject line, tap approve. Five minutes.
section3.p3: Your website is generated from your actual product catalog. Change a price, it updates on the site. Add a product, it appears. No separate CMS to maintain. No sync issues. No "the website says $24.99 but it's actually $29.99 now."

testimonial.quote: "I was living in Shopify, Mailchimp, and Google Sheets simultaneously. Now I check one dashboard in the morning and everything is there. The AI replied to 6 customer emails while I was packing orders. My returns dropped because customers get instant answers instead of waiting a day."
testimonial.attribution: — Ingrid, 29 · Nordic skincare brand · 2 part-time employees

cta.heading: Spend tomorrow making products, not managing software.
